sam_shares.said:
Lent jellyfin (port 8096) to everyone in your groups, as many at once as want it. To let fewer in at once, change it on your home page, or `svrngs share 8096 --limit <number>`.
Each person is signed in to it as themselves by what answers on port 8097, with nothing typed.
svrngs is running here already, so they can open it now.
`svrngs unshare jellyfin` stops lending it.

Lent navidrome (port 4533) to everyone in your groups, as many at once as want it. To let fewer in at once, change it on your home page, or `svrngs share 4533 --limit <number>`.
navidrome signs each person in as themselves, with nothing typed, once it takes them from svrngs: in navidrome, ND_EXTAUTH_USERHEADER=X-Svrngs-User and ND_EXTAUTH_TRUSTEDSOURCES=127.0.0.1/32 in its environment, then start it again.
svrngs is running here already, so they can open it now.
`svrngs unshare navidrome` stops lending it.

Lent shelf (port 60499) to everyone in your groups, up to 1 person at once.
svrngs is running here already, so they can open it now.
`svrngs unshare shelf` stops lending it.
If shelf takes a password on each request, paste what it takes in its Authorization header, then press Enter (Enter alone for none):

ana_join.said:
You're in devices, as Ana.
devices's folder is /tmp/devices-run/ana/svrngs/devices: what anyone in devices puts there reaches this computer, and what you put there reaches theirs.

ana_device_link_said:
A link that adds another computer or phone of yours to devices: open it there, and it joins as you, Ana, asked no name. Send it to nobody else: whoever opens it joins as you. Any link you sent before stops letting anyone new in; everyone it let in stays.
A computer or phone already in devices on its own stays as it joined.
It works for a day, while this computer is on:

  svrngs://join/<the token>

or, to open it in a browser:

  http://localhost:60387/#<the token>

On a phone, each app opens at an address of its own under localhost:60387, which can see which app is opened.

Leave this running; Ctrl-C stops it.
